benefits.name: No GM Intrusion on Stealth
benefits.description: You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on a stealth task.

benefits.name: Light Thrown Weapon Damage
benefits.description: You inflict +1 damage with light thrown weapons.

system.description: Three feet (1 m) tall and proud of every inch, you are fond of the comforts of home but itching for a little adventure now and then. Small and quick, you have a way of getting along with everyone. You might have been raised in a halfling village, a mixed community where humans and the small folk work and eat side by side as friends, or a less welcoming environment where your people get things done using deception and criminal activity. You and humans have a lot in common—you’re just more compact and efficient about it.
